hooks.command: grep -q '\[Example:' PROJECT_BRIEF.md 2>/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"UN-ONBOARDED PROJECT — PROJECT_BRIEF.md still contains template placeholders, so this project has not been set up yet. Run the onboarding flow in CLAUDE.md section 12 NOW, before any other work and before answering questions about the code: (1) run npm install to sync the design system, (2) use AskUserQuestion in batches of up to 4 to gather project details and choose the optional modules, (3) apply the module choices, fill in PROJECT_BRIEF.md, propagate the project name, and allocate a local port. If the user asked for something else, tell them onboarding comes first and offer to run it — a brief filled in now makes every later task cheaper. This notice disappears once the placeholders are gone."}}' || true

f="$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json"; v=$(jq -r '(.plugins["bd@bydefault"] // [])[0].version // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$v" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "The By Default plugin (bd) is NOT installed on this machine, so /kickoff, /handover and the bd-* review agents this project'\''s CLAUDE.md relies on are unavailable. Tell the user before doing anything else. It is a one-time install per machine, run in the terminal app (not the VS Code panel): /plugin marketplace add bydefaultstudio/agents, then /plugin install bd@bydefault, then start a fresh session. This notice disappears once the plugin is installed."}}'; elif ! printf '%s' "$v" | jq -Re 'split(".") | map(tonumber) >= [0,5,0]' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "The By Default plugin (bd) is installed but older than 0.5.0, which is the first version carrying /kickoff and /handover. Tell the user to run /plugin update bd in the terminal app and start a fresh session. This notice disappears once the plugin is up to date."}}'; fi; true
